# Every fuzz target in the repository: package, then target. `task fuzz` runs each
# for FUZZ_TIME; the weekly workflow (.github/workflows/fuzz.yml) runs each for at
# least 60 seconds. A test (docs/fuzz_test.go) fails when a Fuzz function is missing
# from here or from the parser list in docs/architecture.md.
#
# The wire: frames, request headers and bodies, what the recorder says about them.
./internal/protocol FuzzReadFrame
./internal/protocol FuzzParseAndDecodeRequest
./internal/protocol FuzzSkipTaggedFields
./internal/protocol FuzzDescribe
# Record batches, the record reader, decompression, the segment scan recovery runs.
./internal/storage/log FuzzValidateBatches
./internal/storage/log FuzzDecodeRecords
./internal/storage/log FuzzDecompress
./internal/storage/log FuzzCheckRecords
./internal/storage/log FuzzScanLog
# Stored ACL identity.
./internal/storage/meta FuzzACLKey
# Pre-authentication bytes, ACL filters, topic config values, the group state machine.
./internal/broker FuzzSASLPlain
./internal/broker FuzzSCRAMClientFirst
./internal/broker FuzzSCRAMClientFinal
./internal/broker FuzzSCRAMUsernameEscaping
./internal/broker FuzzACLFilterMatches
./internal/broker FuzzTopicConfigValues
./internal/broker FuzzGroupSequence
./internal/broker FuzzDecodeConsumerProtocol
# The configuration file.
./internal/config FuzzConfigFile
# Client telemetry (OTLP metrics).
./internal/telemetry FuzzDecode
# The schema registry: schema texts, wire payloads, REST bodies, descriptors, references.
./schemaregistry FuzzRegisterAndCompare
./schemaregistry FuzzDecode
./schemaregistry FuzzAPIBody
./schemaregistry FuzzDescriptor
./schemaregistry FuzzRegisterReferences
# The console's form inputs, through its handler, against a real broker.
./server FuzzConsoleForms
